integrity: All mathematical statements are proved within the included manuscript, with a standalone symbolic and event-driven checker. No independent publication-priority or scientific audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Two equal-speed, independently flipping particles with independent uniform initial positions and fair headings on a ring; first contact only. Only exact mean, absolute variance and squared coefficient of variation are optimized at fixed total Poisson reversal rate. No full-law stochastic order or extension to different speeds, non-Poisson reversals, or post-contact dynamics is established.
title: Simultaneous mean, variance, and relative-risk optimality of unequal tumbling in two-particle ring encounters
